definitions.explanation: An extendable rod that holds a smartphone or camera at arm's length so the user can photograph themselves with more of the surroundings in frame.

examples.japanese: {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: We used a selfie stick to take a photo with everyone in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The use of selfie sticks is prohibited in this museum.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自撮|じど}り→自撮り：16863_jidori⟧ (taking a photo of oneself) + ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (stick, rod). A 2010s coinage that has settled in as the ordinary word for the device.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a selfie stick
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to extend a selfie stick
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: selfie sticks prohibited
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三脚|さんきゃく}→三脚：06993_sankyaku⟧: a tripod with a selfie-stick function

USAGE:
Signs at museums, temples, and crowded stations often read {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧, so the word is worth recognizing on notices. The English loanword セルフィースティック exists but is much rarer in speech.
